items.title: Roland Hanna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: He said, “Don’t you know about Charlie Parker?” I said, “Bud Powell? Who is Bud Powell?”

ctx.x: Oh gee. I thought you were going to say finally they got me some lessons. © Fillius Jazz Archive -4-

No, no, no. They said you want to bang on it? Bang on it out in the barn. And I did, winter and spring and summer and fall I’d go out there. I got so good I used to cut the fingers off my gloves in the wintertime, and put my coat around my neck and go out and play, and practice that piano. I’d get some hours in some days, until I got old enough and started — it seemed like I was going to be serious about it — I was about ten or eleven years old. And then she says okay, you can get a piano. But I had to go through…
Did you have aspirations to become a professional classical pianist?
